findings.title: HSTS is not enabled in the production pipeline
findings.evidence:
app.UseHttpsRedirection();
// no app.UseHsts() in any environment branch
findings.impact: A user who types the site name without https can be intercepted on the first request; the browser is never told to insist on TLS.
findings.remediation: Add app.UseHsts() outside the Development branch with max-age of at least one year and includeSubDomains.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options header is missing
findings.impact: Browsers may sniff a response as a different content type, which turns some upload or error responses into a script-execution vector. Low: needs another defect to be exploitable.
